row:
This podcast is a feast of inspiring stories and useful information about the physical therapy profession and practice from the experience and expertise of remarkable physical therapists around the world with a Filipino flavor.

Disclaimer:
Greetings everyone, please keep in mind that our podcast is dedicated to providing educational and informative content. We strive to deliver truthful and precise information, but we understand that humans are not infallible. As a result, there may be factual errors or outdated information included in our discussions. We strongly encourage our audience to conduct their own research on the topics we cover and verify their accuracy and validity.
